title: Value Step on Insured Return for Covered Pieces
content:
# Care, Custody and Control Bulletin: The Value Step on an Insured Return

Where a piece worked on under the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service travels back to its owner insured, a step is added to the shipping rate by reference to the value the piece is held at, set against the coverage the piece carries under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans: the price the covered piece was sold at, and how the coverage stands.

1. Where the value the piece is held at is at or above the price the covered piece was sold at and coverage on it stands in force, the upper value step of 45 percent is added.
2. Where that value is below the price the covered piece was sold at and coverage stands in force, the lower value step of 20 percent is added.
3. In any other case no step is added on this ground.

## Both sides of the comparison

| The value the piece is held at | Coverage on the piece | Step added |
|---|---|---|
| above the price the covered piece was sold at | in force | 45 percent |
| equal to that price | in force | 45 percent, the comparison being at or above |
| below that price | in force | 20 percent |
| whatever it shows | not in force | none on this ground |

## A hypothetical reading

A covered piece sold at 4,000.00 USD, with its coverage standing in force: held at 5,000.00 USD, the leg takes the upper value step of 45 percent; held at 4,000.00 USD exactly, the upper step of 45 percent; held at 3,200.00 USD, the lower value step of 20 percent. Where the coverage has lapsed out of force, no step is added on this ground whatever the piece is held at.
